children: RNS Number : 0048D  Eden Biosolutions PLC  13 November 2026

The information contained within this announcement is deemed to constitute inside information as stipulated under the retained EU law version of the Market Abuse Regulation (EU) No. 596/2014 (the "UK MAR") which is part of UK law by virtue of the European Union (Withdrawal) Act 2018. The information is disclosed in accordance with the Company's obligations under Article 17 of the UK MAR. Upon the publication of this announcement, this inside information is now considered to be in the public domain.
US EPA registration for Mevalone Delta

Eden BioSolutions plc (AIM: EDEN), a leader in sustainable biopesticide and biocontrol technologies, announces that the United States Environmental Protection Agency ("EPA") has granted an unconditional registration under the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act ("FIFRA") for Mevalone Delta, an optimised biofungicide formulation based upon Eden’s registered active ingredients and microencapsulation technology, Sustaine® (EPA Reg. No. 92331-6).
Registration covers a variety of fungal diseases on a wide range of high-value crops
The crops covered by the approved label had a combined US farm-gate value of c. $33 billion in 2024
Total addressable market for Mevalone Delta in the US estimated to be in the region of $144 million
Significant opportunity to grow sales across North America

This registration covers the control of a range of fungal diseases on a broad list of high-value crops, including grapes (table, wine and raisin), almonds, strawberries, and other berries. Target diseases on the approved label include grey mould (Botrytis cinerea), powdery mildew, Sclerotinia (white mould), brown rot blossom blight (Monilinia) and chocolate spot (Botrytis fabae). This registration is required before a pesticide can be sold or distributed in the United States and Mevalone Delta will now undergo state-level review and registration, which is expected to take between one and twelve months, depending upon the state.

Mevalone Delta contains the same three naturally derived active ingredients as Mevalone® – eugenol, geraniol and thymol – and is classified by the Fungicide Resistance Action Committee ("FRAC") as a Group BM01 fungicide with multiple modes of action. It is therefore suitable for use in integrated pest management programmes and to delay or prevent the development of resistance to single-site fungicides. The label permits application up to three days before harvest, giving growers flexibility to protect crops late in the season. This optimised formulation allows us to position the product for a wider overall segment, competing in more cost sensitive segments whilst still delivering high levels of efficacy.

The United States is one of the world's largest markets for crop protection products, and the crops on the Mevalone Delta label are among the most valuable grown in the country. Based on USDA data, the crops covered by the approved label had a combined US farm-gate value of approximately $33 billion in 2024. This includes grapes (approximately $6.2 billion), almonds ($5.7 billion), leafy vegetables including lettuce, spinach and celery ($5.5 billion), and strawberries ($4.0 billion). Growers of these crops face increasing pressure from retailers, export markets and regulators to reduce chemical residues, supporting demand for effective biological alternatives.

The Company estimates the total addressable market for Mevalone Delta in the US to be in the region of $144 million, with an expectation of achieving a market share of around 3% at the point of peak sales.
Mevalone Delta will be distributed in the US by Sipcam Agro USA, Inc. ("Sipcam"), Eden's existing US commercial partner for Mevalone.

Sean Smith, Chief Executive Officer of Eden BioSolutions plc, commented: “The registration of Mevalone Delta is another significant milestone for Eden in the United States, one of the world’s largest markets for crop protection products. The breadth of the label, spanning a wide range of high-value crops worth more than $30 billion annually at the farm gate, gives Eden and our partner, Sipcam, a significant opportunity to grow sales across North America.

“Mevalone Delta offers growers an effective, residue-friendly disease control tool with multiple modes of action, which fits well in resistance management programmes and can be used almost up to harvest. As state registrations are secured over the coming months, we look forward to working with Sipcam to bring Mevalone Delta to growers and to providing further updates on its commercial progress.”

Brent Marek, Chief Executive Officer of Sipcam Agro USA, commented: “We are delighted to add Mevalone Delta to our portfolio, following its registration by the EPA. Growers of high-value fruit, vegetable and speciality crops continue to look for effective and sustainable biological solutions that help manage resistance and residues without compromising performance, and Mevalone Delta's broad label and short pre-harvest interval make it a valuable tool for them. We look forward to building on our successful partnership with Eden.”

Eden BioSolutions is the only UK-listed company focused on biopesticides for sustainable agriculture. It develops and supplies innovative biopesticide products and natural microencapsulation technologies to the global crop protection, animal health and consumer products industries.

Eden's products are formulated with terpene active ingredients, based on natural plant defence metabolites. To date, they have been primarily used on high-value fruits and vegetables, improving crop yields and marketability, with equal or better performance when compared with conventional pesticides. Eden has three products currently on the market:

Based on plant-derived active ingredients, Mevalone® is a foliar biofungicide which targets fungal diseases, such as Botrytis cinerea, powdery mildew, and downy mildew, affecting high-value fruit and vegetable crops.  It is a useful tool in crop defence programmes and is aligned with the requirements of integrated pest management programmes. It is approved for sale in a number of key countries whilst Eden and its partners pursue regulatory clearance in new territories thereby growing Eden's addressable market globally. Mevalone Delta is a new, enhanced version of Mevalone®.

Cedroz™ is a bionematicide that targets free living nematodes which are parasitic worms that affect a wide range of high-value fruit and vegetable crops globally. Cedroz is registered for sale on two continents and Eden's commercial collaborator, Eastman Chemical, is pursuing registration and commercialisation of this important new product in numerous countries globally.

Eden's seed treatment product, Ecovelex was developed to safely tackle crop destruction caused by birds - a major cause of losses in maize and other crops. Ecovelex works by creating an unpleasant taste or odour that repels birds, leaving the seeds safely intact and the birds unaffected and free to find alternative food sources. The product is based on Eden's plant-derived chemistry, registered in the EU, US and elsewhere, and formulated using Eden's Sustaine® microencapsulation system.

Eden's Sustaine® encapsulation technology is used to harness the biocidal efficacy of naturally occurring chemicals produced by plants (terpenes) and can also be used with both natural and synthetic compounds to enhance their performance and ease-of-use. Sustaine microcapsules are naturally-derived, plastic-free, biodegradable micro-spheres derived from yeast. It is one of the only viable, proven and immediately registerable solutions to the microplastics problem in formulations requiring encapsulation.

Eden was admitted to trading on AIM on 11 May 2012 and trades under the symbol EDEN. It was awarded the London Stock Exchange Green Economy Mark in January 2021, which the Company still holds to date. The Green Economy Mark recognises London-listed companies that derive over 50% of their total annual revenue from products and services that contribute to the global green economy. Eden derives 100% of its total annual revenues from sustainable products and services.
